info.title: Ruri Cloud Authorization Center
info.description: Single-tier product licensing, test applications, and email-verified authorization lookup and device release. Administrative API requests require an independent bearer credential. License-key-only /v1/self and /v1/release remain unavailable.

servers.description: Service address from the release configuration.

get.description: Returns service readiness; an unavailable authorization service returns 503.
Public distribution settings. Clients pin this key at build time; never replace a trusted key merely because this endpoint changed.
Literal name/email search; items and count describe the same committed snapshot.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Literal substring in name/email; exact license ID also matches on licenses.

post.description: Create purchase contact metadata; this does not create an email-authenticated customer account.

put.description: Full replacement of purchase contact metadata.

get.description: Paginated licenses with their active bindings and total count from the same snapshot; inactive history is queried separately.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Literal substring in name/email; exact license ID also matches on licenses.

post.description: Issue a 31-day pass. Paid passes can activate indefinitely and support manual refunds within seven days of creation while never activated. Trial passes are limited to one per customer and must activate within seven days. Creation confirms payment for paid passes. First activation atomically starts the duration. No payment is executed here.

max_activations.description: The number of devices that can be bound. Defaults to 2 for a trial when omitted.

put.description: Update capacity, revocation, and the expiry of an activated pass. expires_at must be null before first activation and a timestamp after activation.

get.description: Return the current activation key for the selected license, including expired and revoked licenses. Requires an administrator. The response is not cacheable.

post.description: Replace the activation key and return the new key. Existing license ID, bindings and certificates remain valid.

get.description: Paginated active and released bindings for one license.

post.description: Idempotently release this binding only; historical identity cannot release a subsequent activation.

get.description: Paginated license and binding operations. No secrets, raw hardware ID or passwords.

post.description: Reuse one active binding for the same license and instance key. A targetless legacy binding acquires its target when renewed by a current client, without using a new slot. A binding with an explicit target cannot switch targets. Separate instance keys each consume a slot. A signed certificate has a server or android target and grants product rurimecha without a feature list. Older clients may omit target and receive a legacy certificate until their binding has an explicit target. See licensing.md.

403.description: Activation rejected, including license_device_changed when the binding already has a different target.

target.description: Required for current clients. The issuer signs this target into the certificate.

system_device_name.description: Optional user-supplied system device label. An empty string clears this label. Omit this field to preserve the last supplied label.

device_type.description: Optional device platform. Android requires target android. Windows, Linux, and Docker require target server. Omit this field to preserve the last supplied platform.

post.description: Validate the issuer certificate and instance proof purpose=deactivate bound to activation_id and certificate_hash. Certificate expiry and host match are not prerequisites. Idempotent.
Intentionally disabled until purchase-email verification is configured; license key alone is insufficient.
Intentionally disabled until purchase-email verification is configured. Use Core instance deactivation or an authenticated administrator.

Manual refund transition. request locks a never-activated paid pass within seven days of creation. complete records money already returned and permanently blocks activation. cancel reopens activation after a confirmed refund failure or cancellation. request and complete are idempotent.
Replace the key of an unactivated trial once and open a new seven-day activation window. The previous key becomes invalid.

Automatically issue and email one free trial per normalized email address. Repeated requests resend the original trial without extending its deadlines; existing manually issued trials are reused. Declined applications are not automatically reopened. Success is generic and never returns a license key or application status. Requires a license_trial Turnstile token when configured. Limits: 60 seconds between requests, 3 per hour and 10 per UTC day per email, 10 per hour per IP. Shares the daily mail budget with lookup and admin delivery. Mail failures return mail_unavailable and retain an issued trial for a later retry or email lookup. No automatic background retry.

locale.description: Language used for license and lookup emails.

turnstile_token.description: Turnstile response for action license_trial; required when verification is configured.

post.description: Send a one-use lookup link valid for 15 minutes when the email has licenses. Successful responses do not reveal whether the address exists. Trim surrounding whitespace and lowercase the email before all lookups and limits. Each normalized email has a 60-second cooldown, 3 requests per UTC clock hour and 10 per UTC day; each IP has 10 requests per fixed 10-minute window, in addition to the edge per-route limit. Unknown addresses share the same request limits. When human verification is configured, turnstile_token is required and verified for this hostname and the license_lookup action before any email quota is consumed. Query mail and administrator delivery share a daily send-attempt budget (default 100, reset at 00:00 UTC); failed send attempts also consume that budget. A public request checks budget availability before looking up the address.

locale.description: Language used for license and lookup emails.

turnstile_token.description: Required when human verification is enabled. Obtain a fresh Turnstile token for the license_lookup action on the same hostname.

403.description: verification_required; complete or refresh human verification before retrying.

post.description: Consume a one-use lookup token, return licenses and their active device bindings, and set a short-lived same-origin session cookie for requesting a device release email. The session only permits sending a second verification email to the verified address. The cookie expires after 15 minutes.

Set-Cookie.description: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict lookup session cookie.

post.description: Send a one-use device release link to the address verified by the current lookup session. The link is valid for 15 minutes and applies only to the selected active binding. Requests share the daily email budget and are limited per verified customer.
Read only the device details bound to an unexpired release token. The token remains usable for explicit confirmation.

Consume the token and release its selected binding atomically. A concurrent release of the same binding returns released false. Expired, already-used, or mismatched tokens return 403. An existing offline certificate may remain valid until its original expiry.

get.description: List applications for manual review. Supports limit and offset pagination.

post.description: Issue a trial license for a pending application and mark it issued.
Send the current license key to the owner email through the configured mail provider.

ui_locale.description: Language selected when the application was submitted.

Forbidden.description: license_activation_window_expired, license_refund_pending, license_refunded, license_key_invalid, license_revoked, license_expired, or license_activation_limit.

RateLimited.description: rate_limited; wait for the applicable cooldown or IP/email request window to reset. Lookup limits may require waiting until the next UTC hour or day.

Unavailable.description: license_not_configured, license_schema_mismatch, self_service_unavailable, mail_unavailable, mail_daily_limit or verification_unavailable. mail_daily_limit requires waiting until the daily send allowance resets.

adminBearer.description: Independent management credential, not Cloudflare API token
